items.title: 1.8.7 Online and Offline Computing Platforms (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of computing platforms (PDF 30).

blocks.text: Yeh platforms aisa mahol (environment) dete hain jahan developers apna code likh, chala aur test kar sakte hain.

items: Online Platforms: cloud par chalne wale platforms jo internet ke zariye istemal hote hain (misal: Repl.it, Gitpod).
Offline Platforms: apne computer par local development mahol (misal: computer par install kiye gaye IDEs).

blocks.prompt: Online aur offline computing platform mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Online platform cloud mein chalta hai aur internet se istemal hota hai (Repl.it, Gitpod); offline platform aap ke apne computer par install development mahol hai (jaise install kiya hua IDE).

items: Platforms: code likhne, chalane aur test karne ka mahol; online (cloud: Repl.it, Gitpod) ya offline (local IDEs).
